npcs.name: Captain Mara Tenwick
npcs.description: A tall hard-edged woman in storm-stained oilskins, her left sleeve empty and pinned across her chest. Her face is long and weather-burnt; her one good hand is missing two fingers. She watches the chapel with the patient, lethal stillness of a woman who lost a ship and a crew to it.
npcs.dialogueScript:
You came down from the moor. Most don't, these days. I'm Mara — what's left of the Wandering Petrel's crew.

I lost the ship to that thing in the chapel two summers ago. Seventeen souls, the entire crew. I crawled back here on the wreckage, and I've been watching the chapel ever since — listening, mostly. There is a hymn the old Wardens sang to keep it asleep, and I've pieced together the order of the bells from what carries on the wind.

Take this. It's everything I've recovered: the hymn-tablet, with the bells in their right order. North-bell first, south second, crypt third, sub-altar fourth, and the great bell over the threshold last. Ring them out of order and the chapel resets. Ring them right, and the gate opens.

When you find the thing that calls itself Tidewarden Korlach down there, kill it for me, child. I owe it a death and I cannot pay.
